changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders. Genotype spellings merged: Lyamungu 90  (Check) -> Lyamungu 90 (Check); Uyole03  (Check) -> Uyole03 (Check)
